violations.why: Main reads v_drift twice (v_fern and v_thorn are both 1). irq_pebble can preempt in between and write v_drift, because v_quarry is 1.
irq_pebble has higher priority. It can preempt irq_crest after crest writes v_fjord and overwrite it, so crest then reads a different value.
irq_pebble can overwrite v_fjord between crest's write at 159 and its read at 192.
irq_pebble can preempt irq_crest and overwrite v_summit before crest reads it.
irq_pebble can overwrite v_summit between crest's write at 160 and its read at 185.
Crest writes v_kiln[9000]. irq_pebble can preempt and overwrite the same element, so crest's read at 151 sees pebble's value.
